limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses only two transfected L cell lines differing in P-cadherin expression; generalizability to other adhesion molecules or cell types is not tested.
The estimated 20-fold difference in P-cadherin expression is not directly quantified in this paper.
The experiments are performed in vitro; in vivo relevance remains to be demonstrated.
The study does not measure other potential contributing factors such as cell motility or contractility.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

research_questions.statement: Can quantitative differences in expression of a single homophilic adhesion molecule cause cell sorting and specific spatial patterning?

provenance.text_excerpt: When the two cell populations were first formed into separate aggregates which were subsequently allowed to fuse, the cell population expressing more P-cadherin was enveloped by its partner, which formed an external "cortex."

claims.statement: Quantitative differences in P-cadherin expression cause directed tissue spreading, resulting in the less cohesive PLs5 cells enveloping the more cohesive PLβ2 cells.

experiments_or_tasks: Form separate aggregates of PLβ2 and PLs5 cells, pair them, allow fusion in hanging drops, culture on agarose, observe spreading.

methods.name: Aggregate fusion protocol
methods.protocol_description: Separate cell suspensions aggregated individually. Labeled and unlabeled aggregates of appropriate size fused in hanging drops, then transferred to agarose-coated Petri dishes.

study_units.name: Aggregate fusion and tissue spreading assay

provenance.text_excerpt: PLs5 aggregates were observed to spread progressively over the surfaces of the PLβ2 aggregates, completely enveloping the latter in many cases.

results.value_raw_text: PLs5 aggregates spread progressively over the surfaces of the PLβ2 aggregates, completely enveloping the latter in many cases

provenance.text_excerpt: Both the Ca²⁺ dependence of the transfected cells' adhesion and the greater expression of P-cadherin on PLβ2 cells than on PLs5 cells were confirmed by tests of the aggregation rate of both cell populations in normal- and low-calcium medium.

claims.statement: PLβ2 cells express more P-cadherin than PLs5 cells, leading to faster calcium-dependent aggregation.

experiments_or_tasks: Compare aggregation rates of PLβ2 and PLs5 cells in normal and low-calcium medium using light-scattering aggregometer.

methods.name: Light-scattering cell aggregometry
methods.protocol_description: Nearly confluent cultures were trypsinized (0.05% trypsin, 0.53 mM EDTA in CF Hanks'), resuspended at 5×10^6 cells/ml in DMEM ± Ca²⁺ with 2% calf serum, DNase added. 0.55 ml suspension in cuvette with air bubble stirrer, rotated at 37°C. Aggregation monitored by decrease in low-angle light scattering.

study_units.name: Aggregation rate assay

provenance.text_excerpt: PLβ2 cells aggregated rapidly and PLs5 cells aggregated very slowly at normal calcium concentration, but neither cell line aggregated in low-Ca²⁺ medium

results.value_raw_text: PLβ2 cells aggregated rapidly and PLs5 cells aggregated very slowly at normal calcium concentration, but neither cell line aggregated in low-Ca²⁺ medium

provenance.text_excerpt: When the two cell populations were intermixed, they segregated to approach a sphere-within-a-sphere configuration, the cell population expressing more P-cadherin forming islands which fused to become an internal "medulla."

claims.statement: Quantitative differences in P-cadherin expression are sufficient to cause cell sorting into a sphere-within-a-sphere configuration, with the less cohesive PLs5 cells enveloping the more cohesive PLβ2 cells.

experiments_or_tasks: Intermix DiI-labeled PLβ2 cells with unlabeled PLs5 cells, pellet, culture fragments on agarose for 4 days, observe sorting.

methods.name: Cell sorting-out protocol
methods.protocol_description: Cells harvested with 0.01% trypsin + 1 mM Ca²⁺, resuspended in DMEM/2% calf serum, recovered 0.5–2 h. PLβ2 labeled with DiI. Mixed suspensions pelleted, incubated 3–22 h at 37°C to firm, cut into fragments (~0.15–0.3 mm), cultured on 1.25% agarose-coated dishes in DMEM/2% calf serum.

study_units.name: Cell sorting-out assay

provenance.text_excerpt: PLβ2 cells sorted out to form many internal clusters which progressively fused to form an internal spheroidal core or medulla surrounded by a spheroidal shell or cortex of PLs5 cells

results.value_raw_text: PLβ2 cells sorted out to form many internal clusters which progressively fused to form an internal spheroidal core or medulla surrounded by a spheroidal shell or cortex of PLs5 cells
